name: Salice Salentino

known.via: English Wikipedia "Salice Salentino DOC" (redirects to "Salice Salentino (wine)")

terms: Denominazione di Origine Controllata. The label names a precise area, and the wine is tested during production.

notes: Salice Salentino is built on Negroamaro.

blurb.text: A Puglia DOC around the town of Salice Salentino. Its red and rosé are made mainly from Negroamaro, while the white is based on Chardonnay and Aleatico makes sweet and fortified wines.
